items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: No, that was before my time.

ctx.x: Well, I think he had Frankie Dooson for a while. And I think Frankie Barty, motherly, I think that's what Fess told me.
Well, I guess you might have known, uh, probably you might have known, uh, Buddy Johnson and Yang Johnson? No, that was before my time.
That's before your time. I didn't move to Algiers until 1949.
